description: This file defines the EmailTemplate entity class in the OrangeHRM system, using Doctrine ORM annotations to specify database mapping. It models email templates with properties like subject, body, recipient role, performer role, locale, and associated email entity.
external_methods: Doctrine ORM annotations for entity and column mappings

classes.name: EmailTemplate
classes.description: Entity class representing email templates in the system, with properties and getters/setters for template details such as subject, body, roles, and associated email.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the email template.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the email template.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Associates an Email entity with this template.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the locale associated with the email template.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the locale for the email template.

methods.name: getPerformerRole
methods.description: Returns the performer role for the email template.

methods.name: setPerformerRole
methods.description: Sets the performer role for the email template.

methods.name: getRecipientRole
methods.description: Returns the recipient role for the email template.

methods.name: setRecipientRole
methods.description: Sets the recipient role for the email template.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject of the email template.

methods.name: setSubject
methods.description: Sets the subject of the email template.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the body content of the email template.

methods.name: setBody
methods.description: Sets the body content of the email template.
